headline: Vietnam daily port & trade brief — 14 Nov 2026
bullets: 11 container vessels alongside across the four tracked ports; 12 further arrivals expected in the next 24-72 h.
Estimated 49,096 TEU being exchanged today (draft/stay model, uncalibrated).
Official October-2026 trade: exports US$64.67bn, imports US$57.36bn, balance surplus US$7.31bn.
Cai Mep continues to absorb Cat Lai overflow on mainline services; Lach Huyen (Hai Phong) holds the northern deep-water calls.
VPA September 2026: national throughput 2.51m TEU (+11.82% y/y); Cai Mep – Thi Vai +21.48% y/y.
